metaDesc: Hydraulic lift table E1825, load capacity 3T, table size 2000×1450mm, for panel handling in woodworking lines. Factory direct from China.
description: hydraulic lift table E1825 from Shang Rui Machinery. load capacity 3T, table size 2000×1450mm, lifting height 150-1000mmScissor-type hydraulic lifting table for moving heavy panels between machines in a woodworking line, matched to conveyor and machine heights. Supplied by Shang Rui Machinery with CE certification on core models, technical support and lifetime spare parts availability.

faq.q: What load can the Lifting Platform E1825 carry?
faq.a: Rated load capacity is 3T, which covers full stacks of plywood, MDF or solid wood panels in normal panel handling.

faq.q: What is the table size and lifting range?
faq.a: The platform measures 2000×1450mm with a lifting height of 150-1000mm, so it can be set to match the working height of a saw, sander or CNC router on your line.
Control options include foot pedal, button and PLC integration with the line, with limit switches and overload protection as standard.

faq.q: Can it be combined with a conveyor line?
faq.a: Yes. It can be built with a roller deck or chain conveyor platform so panels transfer between machines without manual lifting.
